helpText:
Install / update Extended Hotbar
Install/update installs the included version, not an internet update. MelonLoader 0.7.3 must already be installed. Requires DS_B.0.4.19 / Steam 25154317 and Windows x64 with .NET Framework 4.8.

Prepare a save for the original game and uninstall Extended Hotbar…
EXPERIMENTAL: create a separate campaign copy with four skill bindings and one item slot, then disable Hotbar. The original is backed up and unchanged. Test loading, saving and reloading the COPY before relying on it. Other mods stay installed. Ironmode and unknown formats are refused.

Troubleshooting / undo changes ▾
Undo selected change
Select a backup and undo its file/key changes. Saves are not rolled back. Modified files or keys block automatic restoration.

Fix incorrect key labels only…
Fix Alpha labels by preparing Q/E/R/T, item Y and character keys 1–0. This does not convert a save or remove the mod.

Leave the helper open for load monitoring. It never closes or starts the game. If Hotbar is definitely inactive, original keys can be offered AFTER game exit, with your confirmation.

Backups: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ExtendedHotbarHelper\Backups
Keep them for undo. Language selection only changes this helper. Windows file pickers use your Windows language. Technical diagnostics remain in their original language.

Local unsigned test build. Keep the package's license notices. Game artwork is not covered by the MIT code license.
errorData: The data format is invalid or unsupported. Select a complete, compatible settings backup or test save.
errorAccess: Access denied. Check folder permissions and close programs using these files. Do not disable security software.
errorIO: The file operation failed. Check paths, free disk space and file access. See the diagnostic for details.
errorPackage: The included mod package is incomplete or failed verification. Use an intact helper package.
errorPath: The selected path is invalid or contains a linked folder. Choose the actual local game/profile folder.
errorGame: DungeonSettlers.exe was not found in the selected game folder.
errorBuild: Unsupported game build. This helper requires DS_B.0.4.19 / Steam 25154317.
errorRunning: Close Dungeon Settlers and every test copy before continuing.
errorForeign: An unrelated DLL occupies a Hotbar filename. It will not be overwritten.
errorLoader: Install MelonLoader 0.7.3 for this game first.
errorSave: Select an existing save directly inside the selected profile's Saves folder.
errorSettings: Settings are missing. Set up the game normally first, then close it.
errorKeys: The backup is not a complete original key profile. Choose another pre-mod backup or the original defaults.
errorRecovery: An interrupted change needs recovery. Select its backup and use Undo before making more changes.
errorConflict: A file or affected key binding has changed. Automatic overwrite or restoration is blocked.
errorBackup: The backup is invalid, damaged, already undone or belongs to another folder. Nothing will be restored from it.
errorRecovered: The operation failed and its changes were rolled back. Details and backup location are in the diagnostic.
errorInterrupted: The operation was interrupted and recovery is still needed. Close all game instances, then restore the matching backup.
errorIron: Ironmode saves are not supported for export.
errorSaveVersion: This save version has not been validated for export. The original is not converted.
alreadyCurrent: Already up to date. No files were changed and no additional backup was created.
nothingToUndo: This entry contains no changes to undo. Nothing was restored or removed.

removalSummary:
• Create a separate copy marked {0}. Your original stays unchanged and is backed up.
• The copy uses four skill slots plus basic attack and one item slot. Learned abilities, inventory and progress are preserved.
• Then remove only Extended Hotbar from the game folder. Other mods and MelonLoader stay installed.

Continue only the new copy without Extended Hotbar, not your other modded saves. The two campaigns progress independently.
